title: Surgery Small-Item Value — Reimbursement Method for the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Riverbend's outpatient-surgery small-item list** for the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is: ondansetron (code J2405 under revenue code 0636), dexamethasone (code J1100 under revenue code 0636), cefazolin (code J0690 under revenue code 0636), the splint (code A4570 under revenue code 0270) and the intravenous solution (code J7050 under revenue code 0258); each listed code is read from the charge postings of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) by its charges.

**Small-item test.** A listed code passes the small-item test when its charges on the account are above 0.00 and at or below the payer class's small-denial write-off amount (the payer-class figure in the denial routing schedule); a listed code that does not pass stays with the claim's other denied services.

**Value.** The surgery small-item value is the sum, over the codes that pass, of each code's charges multiplied by the payer class's expected allowed percentage of charges. Each listed code is valued at no more than its own billed charges; the passing codes are then added, the recovery limit applied and the total rounded once.

**Recovery limit.** The surgery small-item value never exceeds what the payer has recovered on the claim, the total of its recovery entries; with no recovery entry on the claim it is 0.00. The surgery small-item value is fixed only after the payer's recovery of its payment stands as a recovery entry on the claim.

**Rounding.** The surgery small-item value is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final total, and when it is 0.00 no entry is written.

**Small-item test at the boundary (hypothetical small-denial amount of 50.00)**
| Code's charges | Passes |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | no |
| 49.99 | yes |
| 50.00 | yes |
| 50.01 | no |

**Worked example (hypothetical, payer class modeled at 50%, small-denial amount 50.00).** Ondansetron charges 40.00 and the splint 30.00 pass; cefazolin at 80.00 does not. Value: 70.00 at 50% is 35.00. With recovery entries totalling 1,000.00 on the claim, the value stays 35.00; with recovery entries of 20.00 it is 20.00; with none it is 0.00 and no entry is written.
